title: Tutoring Intake Checklist
subtitle: Capture learner goal, source work, session schedule, and support need; confirm tutor match and progress checkpoint.
description: Tutoring Intake records learner goal, source work, session schedule, support need, tutor match, and progress checkpoint. Tutoring Intake evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this tutoring intake stage-gated verification when staff must document learner goal and source work. Reconcile session schedule, support need, tutor match, and progress checkpoint before the tutoring intake handoff. Use the intake request, learner work sample, teacher referral if provided, availability calendar, tutor-match rationale, support-route acknowledgment, and first-session plan. For tutoring intake review use, cite source. Match the tutoring intake family or learner wording. Preserve the tutoring intake amendment history and supersession date. Link the tutoring intake source version and meeting notes. Record the tutoring intake learner response and accessibility support. Close the tutoring intake recipient list. Verify tutoring intake documentary provenance. Resolve tutoring intake amendments, superseded wording, and archival distribution for tutoring intake. Ask the assigned tutoring intake reviewer to confirm learner goal against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Tutoring Intake starting details review
sections.guidance: Preserve learner goal, source assignment or assessment, preferred schedule, support need, tutor match factors, session plan, and initial progress checkpoint.

sections.title: Tutoring Intake exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current tutoring intake facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Tutoring Intake required checks
items: Learner goal is identified for this record
Source work matches the current request or source
Session schedule is ready for point-of-use staff
Support need limits or questions are resolved
Tutor match is communicated to the responsible person
Progress checkpoint is confirmed at handoff
A changed tutoring intake fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Tutoring Intake failed or pending items

sections.title: Tutoring Intake readiness
sections.guidance: Hold tutoring intake readiness on any failed or pending item.
